इ-तर (from the pronominal base इ, see इदम्), adj., f. रा, n. रद् (ved. रम्, cf. Lat. iterum),
 1. Other,
; इतर-इतरैर् अथ वा इतरैः, By these or those,
. Contrary, e. g. विजयाय इतराय वा, To victory or defeat,

.
 --Comp.
 --When the latter part of a comp. word it signifies,
 I. negation of the former part, e. g. द्विज-, m. one who is not a Brāhmaṇa,
इतर-इतर, adj., used generally only in the oblique cases of the sing., 1. mutual, with each another, Pañc. ii. d. 136. 2. several
इतर + तस्, adv., Repeated; इतरतश् चेतरतः, Hither and thither,
इतरेतरतस्, i. e. इतर-इतर + तस्, adv. One from the other.

इ + तस् (from the pronominal base इ, see इदम्),
 I. = the abl. of इदम्, Daśak. in
(from this person, i. e. from myself);

, [] than this, i. e. than
 I.
 II. adv.
 1. From hence, from this place,

, against myself.
 3. इतस्-इतस्, Here--there, Śāk. 29, 20; इतश्चेतश् च, Here and there, Pañc. 20, 25.
इतरेतरकाम्या, i. e. इतर-इतर-, f.; instr. sing. according to their several fancies,
